final_message: The panic came from fallback routing setting an internal catch-all `MatchedPath`, which conflicted with nested service routing. Fallback routers now skip setting `MatchedPath`, restoring `ServeDir` behavior while preserving normal matched paths. Added regression tests; all 111 relevant unit tests pass.
